grh_a335ca29ee4eb3e7a129.title: The Strange Affliction
paragraphs: Ned Keesey's wife Jane suddenly develops a bizarre condition that makes nearly everything she says come out in rhyme. Doctors, therapists and assorted cures fail to stop it, and the tendency even seems briefly contagious when people around her begin rhyming too. Jane's brother Harry eventually convinces the couple to treat the condition as a rare talent instead of an illness, and publicity turns Jane into a national curiosity with lucrative television opportunities. On the night of a major interview, however, Jane abruptly discovers that she can speak normally again. The public assumes she was a fraud and her show-business plans collapse, but Jane and Ned realize that the cure they originally wanted has finally arrived and that they still have each other. The closing joke comes when the interviewer himself starts speaking in rhyme.

This [[show|sears-radio-theater|Sears Radio Theater]] broadcast aired on May 29, 1979. It is listed as episode 82 in the archive. [[org|org.8480b75bc0c36e4b|CBS Radio Network]] carried the broadcast. The cast includes Norman Corwin, Nanette Fabray, Steve Franklin, Mary Jane Croft, and Tru Boardman. Other credited names include Norman Corwin as director, Norman Corwin as producer, Norman Corwin as writer, and Andy Griffith as host.
The broadcast is also associated with [[org|org.9b0a0ccffce2f7d3|Sears, Roebuck and Company]].

grh_a32eaa8dd154338ad9e3.title: The Other Grandmother
paragraphs: After the grandmother who raised him dies, young Alex searches his late father's papers and discovers that another grandmother, Lucinda, may still be alive. He finds her in a state hospital, where she has spent roughly forty-five years after typhoid fever, poverty, an absent husband and lost records during the Depression left her institutionalized despite a nurse's belief that she was not mentally ill. Alex and his mother bring Lucinda home, but his grief makes him try to fit her into the place occupied by the grandmother he lost. During a month together, Lucinda gently establishes a different relationship with him. While flying a kite, she teaches Alex that loving something does not mean holding it forever, helping him let go of the past enough to accept the grandmother who is now part of his life.

Other credited names include Fletcher Markle as director, Fletcher Markle as producer, and Pamela Russell as writer.

grh_a36de1d7b9cab80e842a.title: Excalibur
paragraphs: On a stormy night Dr. Christian tells Judy and Dick Foster a deliberately spooky story from a trip to Britain. He and two companions investigate a lake where local legend says Excalibur was cast away and is still guarded by the Lady of the Lake. A mysterious Lady Morgan in white seems to know more about their plans than she should, and when one of the men, Walker, makes a nighttime attempt to recover the sword, he dies in an accident that can be explained by a blow against the boat but leaves several uncanny details unresolved. Dr. Christian never tries again, leaving both the sword and the truth of the legend beneath the lake.

grh_a3eb05f747eb32a1608d.title: Gentleman Of Mystery
paragraphs: Famous author Gerald Halsey returns to Rivers End after years abroad intending to sell the family toolworks, whose new industrial process is important to the war effort. Bitter, detached from his family and contemptuous of patriotism, he seems willing to sell to a suspicious foreign buyer even after his son and young engineer Nick warn him about the danger. Dr. Christian secretly stages a confrontation with an actor posing as the foreign agent, complete with a planted witness and blank cartridge. When the fake buyer threatens the family, Halsey finally fights to defend his son and the process, revealing courage and loyalty he had buried beneath years of cynicism; Dr. Christian keeps the ruse private while Halsey begins reclaiming his place in the family.

grh_a328e22f1db77886094e.title: Home Made Hero
paragraphs: Harvey Gibbons has postponed marriage to Agnes for years while supporting his widowed sister, her children and his mother, and he fears he cannot compete when Agnes's glamorous former sweetheart Mort Hallworthy returns. Agnes is swept up by Mort's confidence and travels with him on the same flight as Dr. Christian and Judy, but a violent storm strips away the glamour when Mort panics and Agnes sees the difference between swagger and dependable courage. Back in Rivers End, Harvey finds work that will ease his family burden, Agnes realizes whom she truly loves, and Harvey finally insists that they stop delaying and marry at once.

grh_a3eb340cdedbe392118f.title: Milk Racket Pt2
paragraphs: As Bob Marvin's manslaughter trial approaches, Dr. Christian keeps digging into the Farmers Protective Organization behind a series of deliberately wrecked milk trucks. He learns that frightened dairymen have joined the organization simply to stop the attacks, confirming that the supposed protection plan is really a racket, and the men behind it increase their threats against him. During an emergency childbirth call, armed men arrive to take Dr. Christian away; he persuades them to let him save the mother and baby first, then keeps his word and goes with them, setting up the final confrontation in the next chapter.
